title: DealsFlagRequest
description: deals.flag-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/offers/:id/flags on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.flag.create; a person): { kind, reason?, duplicate_of? } — duplicate_of (the other deal, id, slug or /d/ link) is required for kind duplicate. An open flag of the same kind by the same person is refreshed, not repeated.
